scope: Proposition 3.1 (Explicit deterministic encoding) of the manuscript “Hardness of finding large independent sets in three-colorable graphs” (preprints/Hardness-of-finding-large-independent-sets-in-three-colorable-graphs-September-24-2026/Hardness-of-finding-large-independent-sets-in-three-colorable-graphs-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 106 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ae304fee9351517), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For fixed choices of the parameters and Label Cover alphabets, this rule constructs a nonempty finite simple unweighted graph in deterministic polynomial time and output size, measured in the size of the explicit Label Cover instance. Composing with Theorem 2.1 for any fixed σ gives polynomial time and output size in the binary encoding length of the original 3-CNF formula.
